name: POSEIDON Advanced
author: wilcox101-maker
description: Keyboard-first educational RF and embedded security lab for M5Stack Cardputer-Adv, for authorized use on owned hardware. Deepwater navy/cyan interface, eleven themes, crisp icons, scrollable help, reduced motion and memory-conscious rendering. Listed below: the current factory image and the republished v0.7.0 factory image. Older catalog rows are omitted because those binaries were not republished.

firmware.name: POSEIDON Advanced v0.9.1 - Deepwater
firmware.description: Source revision 0.9.1 on the wilcox101-maker fork: TRIDENT C5-node release (deauth CMD_STOP path, WiFi-scan malloc terminator, Zigbee enable refcount guard, reproducible libnet80211.a patch script) on top of the official PINGEQUA Hydra pin map (CC1101 CS 13 / GDO0 5, nRF24 CS 6 / CE 4) and shared-SPI / GPS-UART fixes, tracking Evil0ctopus/poseidon_adv. The url points at the 0.9.1 standalone factory image on the wilcox101-maker v0.9.1 GitHub release. Standalone factory image replaces the flash layout. Use poseidon-launcher.bin for existing Launcher installations. Public catalog publication requires the M5Burner publisher account.

firmware.name: POSEIDON v0.7.0
firmware.description: v0.7.0 Community Enhanced Release: Real-time surveillance detection (Flock ALPR / ShotSpotter Raven) integrated into Wardrive with Argus rage reactions. Triton RPG gotchi leveling + persistent XP ranks. 11 Cyberpunk themes with scrolling window & 13 screensavers. Full-width 42-column matrix rain, status bar battery indicator, GATT notification streaming & SD dump, and deep OS/device fingerprinting.
